name: 38108 · Memphis, TN
findings: ZIP 38108 (Memphis) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38108 (Memphis) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 38108 (Memphis) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 24% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
